meta.title: Websites for Lockii rental businesses | Keepsite Media
meta.description: A website built around your Lockii booking widget, for self-service rentals.

hero.heading: A website that books your Lockii rentals
hero.lead: Lockii runs your rentals without staff. We build the website that gets them found and booked, with your Lockii booking built in from day one. We work with rental businesses anywhere.

why.heading: Your website does the job your staff would

points.title: Nobody answers the phone
points.body: An unstaffed rental can't explain how pickup works or whether a hitch is needed. The site has to answer every question a customer would have called about.

points.title: Customers book from their phones
points.body: People search for a trailer or a kayak when they need one, usually on a phone. The site has to show up for that search and reach your booking in two taps.

points.title: A widget needs a home people trust
points.body: Lockii takes the booking, the ID check and the payment. A clear, fast site around it is what gets someone to start.

includes.heading: Every Lockii site includes
items: Your Lockii booking widget, set up and tested
How pickup and return work, step by step
Requirements and rules: ID, hitch, deposit, damage
Answers to the questions customers would otherwise call about
A page for each pickup location
Your Google Business Profile set up and linked

packages.heading: Pick the package that fits your fleet
packages.intro: Every package includes the Lockii setup. The Lockii price applies to the build; the monthly starts after your free month.
packages.moreLabel: Compare everything on the packages page

closing.heading: Let's get your rentals booked.
closing.sub: Tell us what you rent and where. We usually reply within one business day.
